'''Riegenn Hetuu''' was a [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] who was active over a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Codex" /> Around [[3743 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Hetuu was hired by a [[Unidentified Hutt (Riegenn Hetuu)|Hutt]] to acquire a live [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]] queen for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Standard year/Legends|annual]] [[Unidentified annual gladiatorial tournament|gladiatorial tournament]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. Hetuu was successful in acquiring the queen, but failed to take into account the creature's ability to [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduce]]&mdash;when he opened the cargo bay of his [[Unidentified starship (Riegenn Hetuu)|starship]], around four hundred k'lor'slugs poured out and ate both Hetuu and his Hutt client. The incident inspired the term "a [[Hutt's cry]]," which referred to the sound made by a batch of k'lor'slugs, and Hetuu was still viewed as a notorious hunter a century after his [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Riegenn Hetuu was mentioned in the Codex entry for k'lor'slugs in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
